newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Bonds boost trade at Tunis bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bonds boost trade at Tunis bourse.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 0.25 percent in higher trade boosted by exchanges on the bonds' market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 541.20 from 542.50 on Wednesday.
Volume was 4.44 million dinars against 2.13 million dinars.
"Most of the trade was on the bonds' market with a 3.27 million dinars turnover," a broker said.
The first market was quiet excepted the exchange of 31,334 shares of Banque Nationale Agricole at the unchanged price of 33.8 dinars.
The index went down driven by the decline of equipments trading firm Le Moteur by 0.86 dinar to 28.14 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix was down 0.48 dinar to 32.
